hook: What happens when a 550-year-old landmark vanishes into the ocean in just four days?

sections.voiceover: What happens when a 550-year-old landmark vanishes into the ocean in just four days?
Where did the ancient arch go?
That's when a hurricane brushed past the Big Island southern coastline.

Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park officials believe a hurricane caused the 90-foot arch to collapse. Erosion finally claimed the 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch. The 90-foot lava rock structure crashed straight into the Pacific Ocean.
Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park rangers documented the sudden collapse of the Hōlei Sea Arch.
